title: 第88章 灵根觉醒下乡二第87章 灵根觉醒下乡一
slug: 快递通两界我带华夏全民修仙
content_zh:
;;
江小白喝的是朱火灵果稀释液，自从决定要全面觉醒后，李局就让李婉用卖符咒丹药的灵石采购一大批朱火灵果灵植。
这些灵植到达东国后，又经过了常老团队没日没夜的培育，现在已经长成了一大片朱火灵果田，这次的灵液是用催生符催熟多轮朱火灵果后得到的。
所有人喝完朱火灵果稀释液十分钟后，操场上高高的演讲台上走上来一个女人。
她的年纪不大，看起来甚至要比江小白还要小一些，眼睛下挂着一个大大的黑眼圈，整个人身上的疲惫感难以掩盖。
她空手空脚的走上台，看了下面殷切期望的村民一眼，露出一个的笑容，高声道，“大家集中注意力，灵根觉醒马上开始。”
“灵根觉醒的过程会产生剧痛，但这是正常的现象，大家不要太过担心。”
怎么开始？没有看到有什么设备工具啥的啊？
整个操场除了他们这些村民，就只有台上的这个女人和站在操场边成保护姿态的军人。
就在众人心里闪过疑问之时，就见台上那个女人双手一挥，无数颗泛着金色光芒的水滴形物品凭空出现在众人头顶之上。
“哇！”操场上发出惊叹的声音。
台上的女人忽视操场上众人的声音，她的眼神瞬间变得锐利。
众人感觉空气中一股无形的压力朝自己袭来，喧闹的操场瞬间安静下来。
彝海手捏法诀，将骨锥能量精确的打入台下每一个人的丹田，然后启动法阵。
一脸新奇的村民们感觉一股剧痛朝自己袭来，痛苦声，瞬间如浪潮一般此起彼伏的响起。
将骨锥能量打入村民们的身体，并催动法阵后，彝海的工作暂时告一段落。
但是她并没有离开演讲台，而是继续站在原地，观察着下方灵根觉醒的村民们。
一发现不对，她就会立马响应。
她抚摸着手上的空间手环，这是李婉刚刚从修真界寄回的。
有了这个，运送贵重骨锥能量的安全性大大增强，李局已经决定，将空间储物的物品做为下一次采买的重点物资。

江小白痛得恨不得在地上打个滚，但整个操场都是痛倒在地的村民。
他混在其中，也不算很突出了，他死死咬住自己的胳膊，来对抗那股深入骨髓的剧痛。
不知道过了多久，等疼痛褪去之时，他整个人都已经失去了站立的力气。
彝海等村民们歇够了才宣布道：
“本次灵根觉醒已经结束，诸位可以去领自己的手机回家了，后续的修炼事宜，大家关注官方消息就可以。”
东国测灵石只有三块，自然是无法供给全国使用的，想要搞清楚自己觉醒了什么灵根还得开盲盒，能引气入体后才能知道。
这也是没有办法的事，现阶段国家能做到群体灵根觉醒已经很不错了，更多的，只能慢慢来了。
江小白出去的时候，看见操场一边的医疗站内，躺着多名孩子和老人。

Jiang Xiaobai drank the Zhuhuo Lingguo diluted liquid. Since he decided to fully awaken, Director Li asked Li Wan to use the spiritual stones from selling spell elixirs to purchase a large number of Zhuhuo Lingguo spiritual plants.
After these spiritual plants arrived in the East Kingdom, they were cultivated day and night by Chang Lao's team, and now they have grown into a large field of Vermilion Fire Spirit Fruit. This time, the spiritual liquid was obtained after using the birth accelerating talisman to ripen the Vermillion Fire Spirit Fruit for many rounds.
Ten minutes after everyone drank the diluted Zhuhuo Lingguo, a woman walked up to the high podium on the playground.
She is not very old and looks even younger than Jiang Xiaobai. There are big dark circles under her eyes, and the fatigue on her whole body is difficult to conceal.
She walked up to the stage empty-handed, glanced at the eagerly awaiting villagers below, showed a big smile, and said loudly, "Everyone, focus on it, the awakening of spiritual roots will begin soon."
"The process of spiritual root awakening will cause severe pain, but this is a normal phenomenon. Don't worry too much."
How to start? Didn’t you see any equipment or tools?
In the entire playground, apart from the villagers like them, there were only the woman on the stage and the soldiers standing beside the playground in a protective posture.
Just when questions flashed through everyone's minds, they saw the woman on the stage wave her hands, and countless drop-shaped objects glowing with golden light appeared out of thin air above everyone's heads.
"Wow!" There was an exclamation sound on the playground.
The woman on the stage ignored the voices of everyone on the playground, and her eyes instantly became sharp.
Everyone felt an invisible pressure in the air coming towards them, and the noisy playground instantly became quiet.
Yi Hai kneaded the magic formula with his hands, accurately injected the energy of the bone awl into the Dantian of everyone in the audience, and then activated the magic circle.
The villagers with strange faces felt a sharp pain coming towards them, and the sounds of pain suddenly sounded like a wave one after another.
After injecting the energy of the bone awl into the bodies of the villagers and activating the magic circle, Yi Hai's work came to an end for the time being.
But she did not leave the podium, but continued to stand where she was, observing the villagers whose spiritual roots were awakening below.
As soon as she notices something is wrong, she responds immediately.
She touched the space bracelet on her hand, which Li Wan had just sent back from the world of cultivation.
With this, the safety of transporting precious bone awl energy has been greatly enhanced. Director Li has decided to use the items stored in the space as key materials for the next purchase.
Jiang Xiaobai was so painful that he wanted to roll on the ground, but the entire playground was filled with villagers who fell to the ground in pain.
He blended in among them and was not very prominent. He bit his arm to resist the severe pain that penetrated into his bones.
He didn't know how long it took, but by the time the pain subsided, he had lost the strength to stand.
Yi Hai waited until the villagers had rested enough before announcing:
"This spiritual root awakening has ended. You can go get your mobile phones and go home. For the follow-up cultivation matters, you can just pay attention to the official news."
There are only three spiritual test stones in Dongguo, so naturally they cannot be supplied to the whole country. If you want to find out what spiritual roots you have awakened, you have to open a blind box and you can only know after you can draw Qi into your body.
There is nothing that can be done about this. At this stage, the country is already very good at awakening group spiritual roots. More can only be done slowly.
When Jiang Xiaobai went out, he saw many children and elderly people lying in the medical station on the side of the playground.
